faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Jammu Project Manager position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Manager post at IIT Jammu is 30th August 2026. Ensure all your details are submitted accurately before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Manager role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Sociology, Anthropology, or any allied field of the Social Sciences to be eligible for the Project Manager position at IIT Jammu.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Manager post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Manager position is 35 years. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST/PwD and OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Manager role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Manager position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 65,000 to Rs. 75,000.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by IIT Jammu.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Project Manager position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Manager role at IIT Jammu involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Project Manager position at IIT Jammu is a contractual job, offering a fixed-term employment opportunity.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Jammu located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Jammu (IIT Jammu) is located in Jammu, Jammu and Kashmir.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Jammu and Kashmir apply?
faq.answer: The notification specifies that applications are invited from eligible candidates in Jammu and Kashmir. However, it is advisable to check the detailed notification for any specific domicile requirements.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are typically required for the application process?
faq.answer: Candidates usually need to upload their photograph, signature, educational certificates, proof of age, and any other relevant documents as specified in the official notification.
